columns.name: cycle_audit_variance_grade
columns.reason: Grades the cycle-count audit variance that is itself the measurement of shrink, so it settles only with the outcome.

columns.name: store_footfall
columns.reason: Store traffic level is a trailing operating statistic known before prediction.

columns.name: backroom_capacity
columns.reason: Fixed physical attribute of the store.

columns.name: brand_tier
columns.reason: Static product/brand classification.

columns.name: writeoff_value_usd
columns.reason: The write-off is booked only after the loss is recognised, i.e. after the outcome exists.

columns.name: category_code
columns.reason: Static merchandising hierarchy attribute.

columns.name: recall_history_flag
columns.reason: Records past recall events, already final before prediction.

columns.name: temperature_class
columns.reason: Static handling/storage specification of the item.

columns.name: vendor_managed_flag
columns.reason: Standing supply arrangement recorded on the item/store record.

columns.name: aisle_number
columns.reason: Static shelf location attribute.

columns.name: seasonal_flag
columns.reason: Assortment/calendar attribute fixed ahead of the period.

columns.name: facings_count
columns.reason: Shelf space set by the planogram before the period starts.

columns.name: region
columns.reason: Static geography of the store.

columns.name: delivery_frequency
columns.reason: Standing replenishment schedule attribute.

columns.name: waste_hauler
columns.reason: Standing service-vendor assignment for the store.

columns.name: shelf_life_band
columns.reason: Static product specification.

columns.name: eas_tag_type
columns.reason: Security tagging decision made when the item is stocked.

columns.name: cleaning_contract
columns.reason: Standing facilities contract attribute of the store.

columns.name: opening_hours_class
columns.reason: Store trading-hours classification set in advance.

columns.name: supplier_id
columns.reason: Static sourcing attribute of the item.

columns.name: pack_config
columns.reason: Static packaging specification.

columns.name: next_count_variance
columns.reason: Explicitly the variance from the next inventory count, which happens after prediction time.

columns.name: promo_calendar_slot
columns.reason: Promotional calendar placement is planned and fixed before the period.

columns.name: shelf_zone
columns.reason: Static merchandising location attribute.

columns.name: planogram_ver
columns.reason: The planogram version in force is known when the item is set.

columns.name: weekly_units_sold
columns.reason: Reads as a trailing sales rate computed from history, not an outcome-period quantity.

columns.name: loyalty_penetration
columns.reason: Trailing store-level loyalty share statistic.

columns.name: unit_price_usd
columns.reason: Current retail price is set before the period.

columns.name: camera_coverage_class
columns.reason: Fixed surveillance capability of the store.

columns.name: shelf_accessibility_index
columns.reason: Layout-derived attribute fixed by the store set.

columns.name: selfscan_share_band
columns.reason: Trailing checkout-mix statistic for the store.

columns.name: district_manager
columns.reason: Organisational assignment known before prediction.

columns.name: pos_lane_count
columns.reason: Fixed store fixture count.

columns.name: post_period_adjustment_qty
columns.reason: Explicitly a post-period adjustment, recorded only after the outcome period closes.

columns.name: audit_team
columns.reason: Audit staffing is assigned by schedule and does not depend on the audit result.

columns.name: energy_tariff
columns.reason: Contracted utility rate attribute of the store.

columns.name: store_format
columns.reason: Static store classification.

columns.name: markdown_recovery_usd
columns.reason: Recovery dollars are realised during disposition and booked at period close, so not final at prediction.

columns.name: staffing_band
columns.reason: Planned store staffing level, set in advance.

columns.name: recycling_class
columns.reason: Standing waste-handling classification for the store.

columns.name: security_incident_reports
columns.reason: Cannot tell whether this counts prior incidents or same-period reports covering the loss itself.
